review_scope: H61U-H1 evidence, code paths, current static site, and fail-closed artifact policy
reviewer_type: single-agent self-review; not an independent human or third-party peer review

passes.title: Hypothesis, physical mechanism, and preregistration
findings: H61U-H1 uses band 13 only to invert basement depth, then tests basement-depth horizontal-gradient maxima and same-sign flank offsets at 2 km and 4 km before proposing 3-pixel ribbons.
Organizer band 15 is not used as a calibration reference or prediction feature.
GP-1012 is reserved only for depth-scale calibration; the complete official grid is unavailable locally, so no calibration or absolute-depth claim is made.
The named non-fault mimic is a finite intrabasement density sheet/contact with zero basement relief. H61U-H2 and H61U-H3 remain prospective, not post-hoc fallbacks.
passes.limitation: Only the authorized H61U-H1 experiment was run; catalogued faults are proxy truth rather than undisclosed organizer truth.

passes.title: Execution, spatial holdout, leakage, controls, and stop decision

findings.registry_scope: all 748 aligned rasters in accessible sibling GEMS DOE repositories; 61GEMSDOE historical rasters were excluded; private/inaccessible submissions are outside scope
findings.preregistration_scope_deviation: The frozen preregistration called for the full accessible registry, but refresh_registry.py excludes 61GEMSDOE. The reviewer recorded this scope limitation; the sibling-registry stop still blocks the run and no candidate exists.

passes.decision: The HGM comparison does not show a gain and the strict final-dot gate stops file writing. The reviewer also recorded that the scan omitted this repository's historical TIFFs; consequently no exhaustive uniqueness claim is made. No post-hoc pruning, threshold adjustment, TIF, or organizer score was produced.

passes.title: Shared code, compatibility, static site, and artifact safety
maintenance: Removed obsolete unused base-rate/lift constants that described an alternate uniqueness exemption; documented the remaining base-rate comparison helper as diagnostic only.
Kept the strict accessible-registry stop as Spearman >0.90 OR raw within-3-pixel overlap >0.70, without a density or enrichment exception.
Preserved make_folds compatibility for legacy footprint-first ordering, collar_px/min_px keywords, and dictionary-style Fold access; updated stale repository callers and added regression coverage.
Changed the submission checker to refuse historical TIF substitution when the current run card has no candidate.

Recorded that the H61U run used a sibling-only manifest; updated scripts/refresh_registry.py so subsequent refreshes include local historical predictions from docs/downloads, docs/submissions, out, evidence, and reports. The existing run receipt was not recomputed.
